Woman Arrested in US Accused of Spying for China on Taiwan President's Son

The FBI has arrested a woman in California on suspicion of acting as an agent for China and surveilling the son of Taiwan's president. The alleged agent was apprehended in the United States. Reports indicate the woman was accused of spying on the son of the Taiwanese president for China.
